name: subagents-limits
title: Five kittens asked: three work and two wait their turn
about: The agent starts five kittens that each work for a few seconds. Three run at once (the limit for a thread) and two are queued; the cards say Working and Queued and the sidebar row and the activity bar say "3 kittens working, 2 waiting their turn". The queued two start as others finish, and all five reports wake the thread.

steps.text: Check five things [fake:delegate] mcp neko start_subagent {"title":"Check one","prompt":"Look at one [fake:long:8]"} ; mcp neko start_subagent {"title":"Check two","prompt":"Look at two [fake:long:8]"} ; mcp neko start_subagent {"title":"Check three","prompt":"Look at three [fake:long:8]"} ; mcp neko start_subagent {"title":"Check four","prompt":"Look at four [fake:long:8]"} ; mcp neko start_subagent {"title":"Check five","prompt":"Look at five [fake:long:8]"}

steps.expect: Three kittens work and two are queued

see.name: Running: 3 kittens working, 2 waiting their turn

steps.expect: The row and the activity bar say how many work and how many wait
The queued two start as the others finish, and all five report
